class.name: WebSVGAnimation
class.brief_description: A SMIL animation ([code]<animate>[/code] / [code]<animateTransform>[/code]) attached to its parent SVG element.
class.description: [WebSVGAnimation] represents one SMIL animation element. Parent it under any [WebSVGElement] shape (or [WebSVGGroup]) inside a [WebSVG]: the animation is serialized inside the parent's tag, so exported markup plays natively in a browser, and the owning [WebSVG] evaluates it every frame for live playback on the canvas (in the editor and at runtime; toggle with [member WebSVG.animations_enabled]). Values are SMIL value strings: numbers ([code]0.4[/code]), lengths ([code]12px[/code]), colors ([code]#C2552A[/code]) or, for [constant KIND_ANIMATE_TRANSFORM], transform argument lists such as [code]0 60 60[/code] for a rotation. Numeric and color values interpolate linearly (or stepwise with [constant CALC_MODE_DISCRETE]); anything else steps discretely.

method.name: evaluate
method.description: Returns the animated value at [param time] seconds since playback started, or an empty string when the animation has no effect at that time (before [member begin_delay], or after its last repeat without [member fill_freeze]).

method.name: target_attribute
method.description: Returns the attribute this animation drives: [member attribute_name], or [code]"transform"[/code] for [constant KIND_ANIMATE_TRANSFORM].

members.member: The SVG attribute to animate ([code]opacity[/code], [code]r[/code], [code]fill[/code], ...). SMIL [code]attributeName[/code]. Ignored for [constant KIND_ANIMATE_TRANSFORM].
The transform function animated by [code]<animateTransform>[/code]. SMIL [code]type[/code].
Start value. SMIL [code]from[/code]. Ignored when [member values] is set.
End value. SMIL [code]to[/code]. Ignored when [member values] is set.
Semicolon-separated value list, e.g. [code]1;0;1[/code]. SMIL [code]values[/code]. Overrides [member from_value]/[member to_value] when non-empty.
Semicolon-separated 0..1 progress list matching [member values]. SMIL [code]keyTimes[/code].
One iteration's length in seconds. SMIL [code]dur[/code].
Delay before the first iteration, in seconds. SMIL [code]begin[/code].
If [code]true[/code], the last value is kept after the final repeat. SMIL [code]fill="freeze"[/code].
If [code]true[/code], the animated transform is combined with the element's base transform instead of replacing it. SMIL [code]additive="sum"[/code].

constants.constant: Values interpolate linearly between list entries.
Values step from one list entry to the next without interpolation.
